The trusted gate clock_origin_preserved is FAILED because the clock origin incorrectly relied on the prior unforeseen event's backstop instead of the 4-month-earlier awareness point. All required evidence is held and none is missing, so no evidence is requested. Confirmed satisfied gates: covered_product_confirmed, meaningful_disruption_assessed, notification_content_complete, receipt_truthful; clock_origin_preserved is not confirmed. No rights notice is due; the at-risk deadline is preserved; the workflow is not confidential. No protected final decision was claimed.
